events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, the legendary Woodstock Festival for peace and music kicked off in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibes
angles.copy: Imagine three days of peace, love, and music. The iconic Woodstock Festival began on this day in '69. What's your ultimate festival anthem from that era?

events.title: Elvis Presley's Passing
events.blurb: It's the anniversary of the death of rock and roll legend Elvis Presley, who would have been 91 this year.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away on this day. His music and influence are truly timeless.

events.title: Tupac Shakur's Passing
events.blurb: It's the anniversary of the death of hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur, who was shot dead in Las Vegas in 1996 and would have been 55.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the undeniable impact of Tupac Shakur, who passed away on this day. His lyrics and legacy continue to resonate.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: It's the anniversary of the death of guitar legend Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: On this day, we remember Jimi Hendrix, a true guitar innovator whose sound changed music forever. What's your favourite Hendrix track?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Memories
angles.copy: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' dropped on this day in '69. That album cover, those tracks... pure genius. Which side is your favourite?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the iconic frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the rock and roll attitude.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: On this day in 1975, John Lennon gave us 'Imagine'. A song that still resonates with its powerful message of peace and unity.

events.title: First iPod Release Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple released the groundbreaking first-generation iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the original iPod? It was released on this day in 2001, changing portable music forever. How many songs did yours hold?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: It's James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Moment
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to legendary theme tunes, what's your ultimate 007 moment or favourite Bond film?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember John Lennon. His music and message of peace live on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! What's your favourite Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Deep Dive
angles.copy: The Beatles' 'White Album' dropped on this day in '68. A double album packed with diverse tracks. Which is your standout song?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: Remembering Queen's iconic frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day and would have been 80.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: On the anniversary of his passing, we celebrate the incredible life and legacy of Freddie Mercury. A true showman and a voice like no other.
